title: Version number, update button and this log
items: The app shows its version in the sidebar and in Settings → Account.
“Check for updates” pulls the newest version right away instead of waiting for the next check.
After each update, a “What's new” note opens once and then stays out of your way.

title: Friends, Week, Inbox, Topics and account-wide settings
items: Friends: share a study set, friends take your tests, their scores show on a scoreboard, and you see who to beat.
Week: seven days side by side with due work and plan tasks, a load meter per day, and a one-tap rebalance.
Inbox: pages that look like they belong in another notebook get a suggestion. Ask, automatic, or off.
Topics: a map of every topic across notebooks, plus related pages on every page.
Settings are saved to your account and follow you to every device: theme, accent color, text size, scanning defaults, study defaults, planner defaults, grades defaults, export and account tools.
Auto theme follows the device properly, and “Dark at night” switches after 7pm.
Grouped navigation with badges, and a “More” sheet on phones.

title: Homework page and a better test maker
items: Homework is its own section with a full-page report for every check, built for phones.
The test maker has one-tap presets, four short sections, a live summary, and remembers your last setup.

title: Faster, redesigned, and a lot more to do
items: Scanning runs in the background thread and uploads raw images, so the camera never freezes.
New look: graph paper, ballpoint blue, one highlighter accent, and dark mode.

Daily flashcard review, AI study plans, a grades tracker, a 30-day trash with undo, page tools (explain, summary, questions, translate, read aloud, ask), vocab flashcards, planner steps, a command palette (⌘K), paste/drop/PDF scanning, exports, and more.
